newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady vs dlr, forwards edge up.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady vs dlr, forwards edge up.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed steady against the dollar on Wednesday at 35.62/63 level, unchanged from the weekend levels, dealers said.

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI), which has been buying dollars in recent days, was not in the market on Wednesday, they said. The dollar saw a high of 35.6100 and a low of 35.6350, a dealer at a state-run bank said.
The forward premia edged up to end the day at an annualised 8.25 percent for six months, dealers said.
